attributes.probed_form: KEEP: `static inline s32 AudioFreeQueueSlot(u8* state) { s32 slot; s32 off; for (slot = 0, off = slot; slot < 4; slot++, off += 36) { if (*(s32*)(state + off + 1176) < 0) { return slot; } } return -1; }` defined before AudioLoadPart, replacing `for (slot = 0; slot < 4; slot++) { if (*(s32*)(state + slot * 36 + 1176) < 0) { goto gotSlot; } } slot = -1; gotSlot:` with `slot = AudioFreeQueueSlot(state);`. hypothesis.statement: The `add`+`lwz` vs `addi`+`lwzx` form is the next cheapest row and the file-local pointer spelling is NOT the way to get it (measured negative above). The remaining untried spelling is a typed view: declare the 36-byte queue-slot record as a file-local struct and index it, `((AudioQueueSlot*)state)[slot].field`, so the displacement is a member offset the compiler must fold into the load rather than an addend it is free to fold into the index.
